text:
#!name=美柚
#!desc=合并了 2 个原模块。原作者及版本见来源记录。
#!format=sgmodule

# 来源 ext-wool-0351 / 美柚 / 奶思
# 来源 ext-surge-0387 / 美柚去广告 / 可莉🅥[https://github.com/luestr/ProxyResource/blob/main/README.md]

[Rule]
DOMAIN, ad.seeyouyima.com,REJECT
DOMAIN,ad.seeyouyima.com,REJECT,extended-matching,pre-matching
DOMAIN,axxd.xmseeyouyima.com,REJECT,extended-matching,pre-matching

[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^http:\/\/x\.seeyouyima\.com\/adx\/staticstics\?/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/axxd\.xmseeyouyima\.com\/ad\//i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/axxd\.xmseeyouyima\.com\/ad_statistics\?/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/axxd\.xmseeyouyima\.com\/v1\/getad\?/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/axxd\.xmseeyouyima\.com\/pregetad\?/i then reject(404)
^https:\/\/circle\.(xm)?seeyouyima\.com\/v\d\/article_recommend\? - reject

[Body Rewrite]
http-response-jq ^https:\/\/common\.seeyouyima\.com\/v2\/conf_list$ 'delpaths([["data","confList","Minor_mode_card"]])'

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% x.seeyouyima.com, axxd.xmseeyouyima.com, config-service.seeyouyima.com, circle.seeyouyima.com, circle.xmseeyouyima.com, common.seeyouyima.com
